about: A non-normative profile: interoperability with keripy 1.x, not conformance. No specification defines the CESR 1.00 count-code table that keripy 1.x uses, so every assertion here rests on the named implementation's behaviour (level INTEROP, with a basis) instead of a clause. Passing it is never a conformance claim. This file is generated by scripts/regenerate from scenarios/cesr/ and must not be edited. Fields: name; normative (false); basis (the implementation and commit the expected values come from); cases (the case ids, in order).
name: keripy-1x-interop
